change: Carry existing immutable ScopeDirectiveFacts in each LoweredFunctionDefinitionStatement, constructed once at the single lowering site. Reuse in GeneratorCode construction, executable function-code construction and both runtime PyFunction fallback constructors.
expectedRemoval: Remove repeated per-definition ScopeDirectiveFactsCollector.ForFunction traversals and their transient parameter arrays/hash sets. No new cache/registry/layout/lookup protocol; same existing facts type.
compatibility: Facts must be derived after prepared lexical/class-cell binding is final. Share only syntactic facts, never defaults/cells/mutable type graphs/hosts/contexts. Facts become compiled metadata and remain charged to existing conservative compiled owner. One extra retained reference and potentially more upfront work for never-executed definitions are tradeoffs, to measure.
acceptance: Before edit verify record transformations do not change binding names/class-cell requirements after lowering, and facts consumers never mutate sets. Reuse relevant class-cell/default/closure/generator/generic/suspending-definition regressions. Freeze one native class-method/lowered-definition construction pair with ordinary executable controls and a short fresh-compile/run control; require lower runtime allocation and unchanged behavior/owners, report compilation retention/cost.58 complete jobs; no retiming or broad qualification campaign.
stopping: Only function-definition facts metadata and named consumers. No frontend pass fusion, scope analyzer framework, class layout, lambda representation or ownership audit. Reassess before edit if mutable/preparation timing needs a different facts model.
